page_title: GIR 2-2 CEL | Girona v Celta Vigo 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+2' PENALTY APPEAL after Cristhian Stuani (Girona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
84' Here comes a substitution. Portu (Girona) is brought on as a substitute for Bryan Gil.
84' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Alfonso Gonzalez and he is replaced by Jailson (Celta Vigo).
84' It's time for a substitution. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) comes on in place of Ilaix Moriba.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yaser Asprilla (Girona) replaces Viktor Tsygankov.
79' Vicente Guaita stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom left corner.
77' A cross from a corner kick by Celta Vigo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

77' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) is coming onto the pitch as Iker Losada cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) replaces Pablo Duran.
68' 2 - 2 A perfectly executed corner kick finds the head of Yangel Herrera (Girona) who finishes precisely, off the post into the left side of the goal.
68' Substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) on for Bojan Miovski.
68' The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.
66' Bryan Gil (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
65' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for an infringement.
65' A cross into the box from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is cleared.
62' That was close by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
61' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.

59' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
55' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
54' Michel decides to make a substitution. Oriol Romeu will be replaced by Ivan Martin (Girona).
54' That will be all from David Lopez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Arthur Melo (Girona).
51' 1 - 2 Goal! Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Paulo Gazzaniga into the bottom left corner.
51' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
50' Foul! David Lopez (Girona) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Celta Vigo.
48' The attendance for today's match is 11449.
47' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) commits a rough foul. Miguel Ortiz stops the game and makes a call.
47' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' David Lopez (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
45+2' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+2' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His low effort towards the bottom left corner is stopped by Vicente Guaita, who pulls off a glorious save! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Girona.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

45' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for an infringement. Girona are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
40' Celta Vigo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
40' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo win a corner kick.

36' 1 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Sergio Carreira picks out an unmarked Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
35' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
35' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
33' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

32' Oriol Romeu (Girona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Miguel Ortiz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
30' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

27' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Paulo Gazzaniga is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
26' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Yangel Herrera gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Viktor Tsygankov (Girona), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 1:0.
21' POST! Oriol Romeu (Girona) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
20' Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo).
17' Claudio Giraldez is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) suffers an injury and Alfonso Gonzalez comes on.
16' The game is interrupted now, Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
13' None of the Girona players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
10' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) makes a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.

9' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Celta Vigo are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

6' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Paulo Gazzaniga.
4' Oriol Romeu (Girona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
4' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Celta Vigo will have the kick-off.
Miguel Ortiz got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
